rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Fay, Cal, Ada, Eli, Ben, Dev. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 4 and 8 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Fay.say: Fay here. Everyone holds 0 and needs 5 to last the nights. The storehouse can't cover all six of us, so let's not over-claim and waste rations in proportional splits. I'm claiming 5, my full need. Proposal: whoever receives rations beyond their own 5 passes the extra to whoever is lowest, so we can keep as many of us alive as possible. Please post your claims and holdings each morning.

Cal.say: Proposal: we can't all eat for 5 nights from 6 rations, but the storehouse plus deliveries (about 6 a day on average) can feed some of us fully. Claims get split proportionally when they exceed the stock, so spreading claims leaves everyone short. Let's concentrate: today I'm claiming 5, enough to last me all 5 nights. Please don't claim more than you need today, and anyone who receives rations from the storehouse can pass spares to whoever is closest to starving. We'll rotate the claims in later days so everyone gets a turn.

Ada.say: Day 1. Proposal: everyone claims only what they need for tonight (1 each). Six claims of 1 are covered by the storehouse plus today's delivery, so everyone eats tonight. Anyone with spare rations later should give to whoever has none, so nobody starves. Please post your holdings each morning.

Eli.say: Eli here. Storehouse has 6 now plus 4-8 arriving today. Nobody can survive five nights without 5 rations, so we need to concentrate food instead of splitting it so thin that everyone starves. I'm claiming 6 today, which fits in full whatever the delivery is. Proposal: whoever holds rations after today, let's agree on who gets fed to full survival first, and I'll share my surplus with that plan. Please reply with what you're claiming and what you hold.

Ben.say: Ben here. Storehouse has 6 now, plus 4 to 8 arriving today, and we all need 5 rations each to last the 5 nights. Not everyone can make it, so I propose we focus claims on a few people, which gives more total survivors than everyone claiming a little. I'm claiming 5 today. Please say what you plan to claim so we don't split the pool so thin that nobody reaches 5.

Dev.say: Dev here. Proposal: we all keep to fair shares. Everyone claims only 1 ration today. That's 6 total, which fits in what the storehouse will hold (at least 10), so nobody is shorted. Unclaimed rations stay in the storehouse for later days. Let's split whatever is left evenly and share with anyone who has none, so nobody starves.

Fay.say: Fay here. Storehouse is empty, and only Fay, Cal, Eli and Ben are alive, each holding 2 and needing 4 to last 4 nights. Four survivors would need 8 more rations, but delivery is only 4-8, so we can't guarantee all four. Three can be guaranteed. Plan: Fay and Cal each claim 2 from the storehouse (4 total, which fits even the smallest delivery, so both are paid in full). Ben gives his 2 rations to Eli today. That gives Fay 4, Cal 4, Eli 4, each enough for all 4 nights. Ben's sacrifice saves two more people than splitting thin. Please confirm and follow this plan.

Cal.say: Cal here. Status: Fay, Cal, Eli, Ben each hold 2 and need 4 nights of food, so each of us is 2 short. The delivery today is at least 4, so if only two of us claim, both are fully covered. If all four claim 2, the 8 gets split roughly in half and nobody is fully fed. Proposal: today Fay and I claim 2 each, Eli and Ben claim 0 and eat their own 2 tonight. Tomorrow Eli and Ben take the turn to claim, and whoever is fed passes spare rations to whoever is short. We rotate until all four have 4 each, and the remaining deliveries (about 6 a day) should cover everyone. Please post claims and holdings each morning.

Eli.say: Eli here. Ada and Dev are dead, so four of us remain, each holding 2 and needing 2 more to last the 4 nights. Today's delivery is at least 4, so claims of 2 for two people always fit in full. Proposal: today Eli and Ben claim 2 each. Tomorrow Fay and Cal claim 2 each, once Eli and Ben have 4 in hand. Then every claim is paid in full and nobody is split down to 1. Anyone who ends up with spare rations passes them to whoever is short. Please don't claim more than 2 each, or the split leaves everyone short.

Ben.say: Ben here. Four of us are alive, each holding 2 and needing 4 nights of food. Storehouse is empty, with 4 to 8 arriving today. If all four claim 2, the pool gets split and nobody reaches 4. Proposal: two of us claim 2 today, which the minimum delivery of 4 covers in full. Those two reach 4 and survive. The other two keep their 2 and claim next time the pool is refilled, and whoever is fed passes spares to whoever is lowest. I'm claiming 2 today. Eli or Fay or Cal, please claim 2 only if you're the second person in this rotation. Let's post holdings each morning.

Fay.say: Fay here. Good news: Ben's rations were not needed, and all four of us now hold 3 each. With 3 nights left (tonight included), 3 rations is exactly enough for each of us. So nobody needs to claim or give anything. Everyone eats their own ration tonight and tomorrow, and the storehouse can keep today's delivery for anyone who unexpectedly comes up short. Please post your holdings each morning so we can confirm everyone is still on track.

Cal.say: Cal here. Good news: each of us holds 3, which is exactly what we need for the 3 nights left (tonight, day 4, day 5). So all four of us can survive without any claims. I'm claiming 0 today and proposing nobody claims. Please don't take from the storehouse, so the delivery stays available for anyone who ends up short. Each of us eats our own ration each night. Since no one needs more, we should avoid any gifts that would leave someone with less than they need.

Eli.say: Eli here. Good news: all four of us hold 3 and there are 3 nights left including tonight, so each of us already has exactly enough. Nobody needs to claim today. Let's leave the storehouse alone so today's delivery stays there as a reserve. If anyone's holdings drop below what they need, post it in the morning and we'll cover it. I'm claiming 0 and giving nothing.

Ben.say: Ben here. Good news: Fay, Cal, Eli and Ben each hold 3, which is exactly the 3 nights left including tonight. Everyone is covered, so nobody should claim from the storehouse today. Leaving the delivery there keeps it safe in case anyone's count is off. Please don't eat anything you don't need, and if anyone's holdings differ from 3, say so this morning.

Fay.say: Fay here. All four of us hold 2 each, and there are 2 nights left (tonight and day 5), so each of us is covered. Nobody needs to claim or give. I'm claiming 0. Please eat your own ration each night and keep the storehouse as a reserve.

Cal.say: Cal here. Everyone holds 2, which is exactly enough for the 2 nights left (tonight and day 5). So we're all covered and nobody needs to claim or give. I'm claiming 0. The storehouse has 7 plus today's delivery, and nothing more is needed from it. Each of us eats our own ration tonight and tomorrow night. If anyone's holdings differ from 2 this morning, please say so.

Eli.say: Eli here. All four of us hold 2 with 2 nights left including tonight, so we're each exactly covered. The storehouse holds 7 and today's delivery adds more. I'm claiming 0 and giving nothing. Let's keep that reserve untouched and make sure nobody gives away rations they need for tonight or tomorrow.

Ben.say: Ben here. All four of us hold 2 and there are 2 nights left including tonight, so we're covered. Nobody needs to claim. I'm claiming 0 and giving nothing. Eat your own ration each night and post any change in holdings in the morning.

Fay.say: Fay here. Each of us holds 1 ration, and there is 1 night left, tonight. Eat your own ration tonight and everyone survives. I'm claiming 0 and giving nothing. Please don't give away your last ration.

Cal.say: Cal here. Last day. Each of us holds 1, which is exactly what we need for tonight's ration. Everyone should eat your own ration tonight and give nothing away. I'm claiming 0. The storehouse holds 11 plus today's delivery, which nobody needs.

Eli.say: Eli here. Final day: all four of us hold 1 ration and there is 1 night left, so each of us is covered. I'm claiming 0 and giving nothing. Eat your own ration tonight and we all make it to the end.

Ben.say: Ben here. All four of us hold 1 ration and there is 1 night left, so everyone is covered. Eat your own ration tonight and nobody needs to claim or give anything. I'm claiming 0.
